item.title: OpenAI-Backed Ballot Measure Draws Scrutiny From Child Safety Advocates
item.description: A group of kids' safety advocates says the proposed Parents & Kids Safe AI Act provides insufficient protection.

item.title: Bad Bunny at the Super Bowl: Fans Feel Pride, but Also Fears of ICE
item.description: The Bay Area is gearing up for ‘Benito Bowl,’ AKA Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl halftime show performance, with watch parties planned across the Bay.

item.title: Immigrants Suing ICE Over Detention Conditions Get Their Day in Court in SF
item.description: A lawsuit being heard in federal court in San Francisco alleges meager medical care, inadequate access to lawyers and punishing treatment at the detention center in California City.

item.title: Super Bowl LX Gives Flag Football the Spotlight Ahead of 2028 Olympics Debut
item.description: Flag football has exploded in popularity worldwide. Players see the next Summer Games in Los Angeles as a chance to compete at a high level.

item.title: In the Mission, a Bad Bunny Look-Alike Contest Becomes a Celebration of Identity
item.description: In San Francisco’s Mission District, hundreds gathered for a Bad Bunny look-alike contest to celebrate the global superstar just days before his Super Bowl halftime show.

item.title: Snap Judgment: Jen Angel
item.description: After Oakland baker and activist Jen Angel was killed in a botched robbery, her community rallies for restorative justice instead of retribution.

item.title: SF Schools Will Close if Teachers Strike. Here’s How City Hall Plans to Step In
item.description: San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie said city departments will offer free meals and some extended child care services on day one of a strike set for next week.

item.title: Sign Language Interpreter Will Also Make History During Super Bowl Halftime Show
item.description: For the first time, Puerto Rican Sign Language will be in the spotlight on one of the country’s biggest stages.

item.title: He’s Photographed Every Super Bowl. Will This One Be His Last?
item.description: When Super Bowl LX gets underway, there will be one photographer on the sidelines who has snapped shots at every Super Bowl game. John Biever was 15 when he took photos at the first Super Bowl; he says this one will likely be his last.

item.title: As Super Bowl Nears, Bay Area Braces for ICE Activity Despite Official Statements
item.description: Fears about a possible ICE presence in the Bay Area during the Super Bowl continue to simmer even as officials insist there are no planned enforcement operations tied to the game.
